description.summary: The Akira Class was put in production in 2355 to provide offensive strength during the Cardassian War. The Akira has since been refit to become an invaluable asset to Starfleet, first by helping repel the Borg Offensive of 2373, and later in the Dominion War. Its extensive shielding, manoeuvrability, and powerful phaser banks make it useful in both offensive and defensive situations.
Freighter outfitted with construction equipment, carries and maintains a flight of construction bees which can build spacebourne installations

ships.name: Construction Bee
ships.subtitle: Repairs and builds ships and stations

description.summary: Originally designed as a larger vessel, the Defiant was redesigned in 2367 by Benjamin Sisko to be the most powerful ship in her size range, but lack of foresight led to a number of design flaws that would keep the ship out of mass production. Combat trials with the refurbished prototype showed the need for a smaller, less powerful warp core for mass production. Once fitted, the Defiant was quickly brought into mass production

Intended to be the new face of Starfleet's exploritory efforts for the next century, the Galaxy-Class has been pressed into combat as the new standard capital ship for Starfleet's battle groups.
Capable of seperating its saucer in emergency situations.

Designed in 2370 as a deep-space exploration vessel with teeth, the Intrepid underwent a minor design change after the incident in the Hekaras Corridor. Faster then almost any ship in the fleet, the Intrepid can hold her own against most ships in her weight range, but will struggle against larger ships.

Designed as the final iterative step in the Galaxy Development Program and to serve the Galaxy as was the Miranda was to the Contitution, the Nebula Class starships have been refitted for combat against the Borg and the Dominion. With an extensive array of multi-purpose weaponry and new technology at its disposal the Nebula is a great compliment to the Federation fleet. In addition to the Nebula's phaser banks, it can be outfitted with three different modules to suit the tactical situation.

variants.label: Adv. Sensor Phalanx
variants.description: Adds an Advanced long range Sensor Phalanx

description.summary: Another replacement for the Miranda-Class in the logistical role, the Norway is far larger and more heavily armed then the Miranda, allowing it to hold its own in battle against the Cardassians and the Borg after Wolf 359.

The long-awaited successor to the Oberth, the Nova was originally the concept for the Defiant-Class until Benjamin Sisko took over the project. Starfleet resurrected the design to succeed the Oberth as a scout vessel.
Can be retrofit to lay mines.
Converted Academy flight trainer and courier for anti-capital attack. Not very effective against small ships.
Stationary weapons platform, good against smaller ships, work best in groups

abilities.name: Manheim effect
abilities.detail: Superweapon: a temporal field that freezes ships in place.

description.summary: Sensor pallet that can remotely relay data without risking ships or crew

The latest from Starfleet R&D, the Prometheus is a formidable, if exceptionally complicated, warship already it can create a tactical advantage where none exists by splitting into three semi-independent starships with its Multi Vector Assault Mode
Enginnering support vessel. Can project energy reserves directly onto allied ships to bolster shields. Also carries supplies to aid rapid repairs in battle situations
Cargo bee outfitted with dilithium collection equipment
Freighter outfitted with dilithium processing equipment, carries and maintains a flight of cargo bees outfitted for mining

Designed to replace the Miranda-Class in patrol and logistical roles, the Sabre is far more heavily armed then the base Miranda, but production only ramped up after Wolf 359.
Best used in 'wolfpacks' alongside Defiants.
Constructs most Federation starships, can also dock one vessel for repairs at a time
Constructs destroyers and light to midweight cruisers, can also dock one vessel for repairs at a time

The Sovereign is the Federation's second most advanced starship, designed as the most conventional and ultimately successful option to defend against the Borg. The Sovereign is heavily shielded and armed with powerful phasers and quantum torpedoes.

The Steamrunner-Class was originally produced during the Cardassian Wars in the 2350s, but undersaw a massive refit program in 2368 after Wolf 359 to defend against the Borg. As a result, the Steamrunner is armed with long range Tricobalt torpedoes. These torpedoes can be fired from long range and cause massive explosions that damage everything within range. As a consequence for the tremendous energy it takes to fire its weapons, the Steamrunner tends to be slower and have less shielding than its counterparts, making it an easy target if engaged at close range.
The brainchild of Dr Paul Manheim, this station is the first generation of applied temporal warfare
Stationary weapons platform, good against larger ships, work best in groups
The first generation Valkyrie-Class fighter,armed with fore and aft pulse phasers give excellent defensive capabilities.
Heavier version of the Mk I Valkyrie, dual forward pulse phasers make it harder hitting on strafing runs
The largest fighter in the Valkyrie series, this craft sports a phaser strip on the nose of the craft, making it suited for anti-capital duities.

The Venture is one of the newest additions to Starfleet, with production beginning in 2373. It is a lightly armoured highly manoeuvrable scout vessel capable of space and atmospheric flight. This vessel is primarily designed for reconnaissance and short range exploration. It is equipped with a forward firing pulse phaser, should it need to engage in combat.
